specials.title: Pixel Penguin #1 — GO 제우스 (GO Zeus)
specials.description: Pixel Penguin 10K #1 Special 1-of-1 Animated Original — GO 제우스 (GO Zeus). Olympian storm ruler adorned with gold-rim square glasses and the signature GO royal mantle amidst crackling thunderbolts. Mint Price: 100 VERY.

specials.title: Pixel Penguin #2 — 천상의 대천사 (Celestial Archangel)
specials.description: Pixel Penguin 10K #2 Special 1-of-1 Animated Original — 천상의 대천사 (Celestial Archangel). Guardian of the golden sanctuary with a radiant floating halo, seraphim white wings, and celestial feather light. Mint Price: 100 VERY.

specials.title: Pixel Penguin #3 — 심연의 마왕 (Infernal Overlord)
specials.description: Pixel Penguin 10K #3 Special 1-of-1 Animated Original — 심연의 마왕 (Infernal Overlord). Dark obsidian demon penguin crowned with crimson horns and fiery glowing eyes amidst rising hellfire embers. Mint Price: 100 VERY.

specials.title: Pixel Penguin #4 — 한밤의 탈옥수 (Midnight Outlaw)
specials.description: Pixel Penguin 10K #4 Special 1-of-1 Animated Original — 한밤의 탈옥수 (Midnight Outlaw). Moonlit prison escapee wearing a red knit beanie, black-and-white striped prisoner uniform, and a broken iron shackle chain over the shoulder. Mint Price: 100 VERY.

specials.title: Pixel Penguin #5 — 빙하의 제왕 (Glacier Emperor)
specials.description: Pixel Penguin 10K #5 Special 1-of-1 Animated Original — 빙하의 제왕 (Glacier Emperor). Sovereign of the aurora ice palace wearing a crystalline spire crown and royal fur-trimmed glacier mantle amidst a swirling frost flurry. Mint Price: 100 VERY.

specials.title: Pixel Penguin #6 — 심해의 지배자 (Abyssal Sea Ruler)
specials.description: Pixel Penguin 10K #6 Special 1-of-1 Animated Original — 심해의 지배자 (Abyssal Sea Ruler). Monarch of the bioluminescent deep wearing a golden coral sea crown and pearl-trimmed scale mantle surrounded by glowing jellyfish and rising bubbles. Mint Price: 100 VERY.

specials.title: Pixel Penguin #7 — 시공간의 지배자 (Chronos Time-Space Ruler)
specials.description: Pixel Penguin 10K #7 Special 1-of-1 Animated Original — 시공간의 지배자 (Chronos Time-Space Ruler). Master of the clockwork sanctum with emerald-and-gold heterochromia eyes, a golden clockwork crown, and an hourglass medallion cloak encircled by temporal orbit rings. Mint Price: 100 VERY.

specials.title: Pixel Penguin #8 — 황금 파라오 (Golden Pharaoh)
specials.description: Pixel Penguin 10K #8 Special 1-of-1 Animated Original — 황금 파라오 (Golden Pharaoh). Ancient solar monarch wearing the royal blue-and-gold Nemes headdress with Uraeus cobra and a lapis scarab Usekh gold collar before golden pyramids and glowing Ankh runes. Mint Price: 100 VERY.

specials.title: Pixel Penguin #9 — 사이버 네온 군주 (Cyber Neon Overlord)
specials.description: Pixel Penguin 10K #9 Special 1-of-1 Animated Original — 사이버 네온 군주 (Cyber Neon Overlord). Ruler of the rain-lit cyberpunk metropolis wearing a neon crystal cyber crown, holo-spectrum visor, and neon-trimmed cyber mantle with gold chain. Mint Price: 100 VERY.

Mint Price: 100 VERY.

specials.title: Pixel Penguin #11 — 밤의 신사 탐정 (Nocturne Gentleman Detective)

Aristocratic nocturnal sleuth on a gaslit gothic street, dressed in a purple-banded black silk top hat, gold chain monocle, Victorian cape with crimson bowtie, and curved-gold gentleman umbrella. Mint Price: 100 VERY.
